hazards.description: A parked van on the left side of the street blocks sight lines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, parked near the sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: No physical buffer, such as a planting strip or parked cars, exists between the sidewalk and the high-speed travel lanes.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line adjacent to the sidewalk

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway and painted median require a long crossing distance without any physical refuge or marked crossing.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median refuge or signal control.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration requires pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of roadway at the intersection, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Intersection
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian infrastructure at the junction where the side street meets the main road.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground at the intersection of the two streets

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian crossings
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible within the immediate vicinity, forcing pedestrians to cross at unprotected locations.

hazards.name: Wide multi-lane roadway
hazards.description: The four-lane configuration encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases crossing difficulty for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of midblock crossings
hazards.description: Despite commercial land use, there are no marked crossing points, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: A large van parked at the curb blocks sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for an extended period without a refuge.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked truck
hazards.description: A large truck parked near the intersection may block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the corner

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb block the line of sight between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, parked SUV

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers, especially children or those in wheelchairs.

interventions.title: Road Diet and Lane Narrowing

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the curb cut to defined entry and exit points to minimize the conflict area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk material and level across the driveway to clearly indicate pedestrian priority and slow entering vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer/Bollards
interventions.description: Install bollards or a planting strip to physically separate the sidewalk from the parking area.

interventions.title: Road Diet / Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow traffic and repurpose the space for a buffered bike lane or wider sidewalk buffers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and RRFBs (Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons) to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Curb Management and Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Define specific entry and exit points for the gas station using curbs and landscaping to reduce the area of conflict between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with continental striping to improve visibility of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the frontage.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle access, clearly defining the pedestrian path with continuous sidewalk materials.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street trees and buffers
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees on the left side to create a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a furniture zone with street trees to provide a physical buffer and improve the psychological comfort of pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Convert the painted median into a raised concrete refuge island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing the street.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island and high-visibility signage to facilitate safe crossing to the church.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase the distance between pedestrians and traffic.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of through lanes to provide space for a dedicated bike lane or wider sidewalk buffers, slowing traffic and reducing crossing distance.
